name_zh: 侯赛因/哈希姆王朝：王朝守护与生存外交
name_en: Hussein/Hashemite Dynasty: Dynastic Guardian & Survival Diplomacy
description_zh: 约旦侯赛因·本·塔拉勒 (1935-1999) 国王 (1952-1999)/哈希姆王朝/麦加守护者/阿卜杜拉一世/侯赛因/阿卜杜拉二世/1946 独立/1967 六日战争/约旦河西岸/巴解组织/黑色九月/1994 和平条约/以色列/巴勒斯坦/美国/伊拉克/海湾战争/民主化/继承/阿卜杜拉二世。核心模式：王朝守护生存外交 — 哈希姆合法性/麦加守护/巴勒斯坦/以色列/美国/伊拉克/海湾/生存/调解/继承/稳定/现代化。体现 M173 王朝守护合法性 — 以"哈希姆血统+麦加守护+生存外交+继承稳定"四位一体，在巴以/海湾/大国/国内四重夹击中守护哈希姆王朝生存。
description_en: Jordan Hussein bin Talal (1935-1999) King (1952-1999)/Hashemite Dynasty/Mecca Guardian/Abdullah I/Hussein/Abdullah II/1946 independence/1967 Six-Day War/West Bank/PLO/Black September/1994 Peace Treaty/Israel/Palestine/US/Iraq/Gulf War/democratization/succession/Abdullah II. Core model: Dynastic Guardian Survival Diplomacy — Hashemite legitimacy/Mecca guardianship/Palestine/Israel/US/Iraq/Gulf/survival/mediation/succession/stability/modernization. Exemplifies M173 Dynastic Guardian Legitimacy — quaternity of 'Hashemite bloodline + Mecca guardianship + survival diplomacy + succession stability' guarding Hashemite dynasty survival amid quadruple squeeze of Israeli-Palestinian/Gulf/great powers/domestic.
reason_zh: 约旦非单纯小国，而是"哈希姆血统+麦加守护+生存外交"三位一体王朝国家。哈希姆血统连接先知/麦加，侯赛因以生存外交平衡以/巴/美/伊/海/美，继承稳定确保王朝延续。M173 区隔于 M183 原住民自决(玻利维亚)、M170 部落联邦(阿富汗)、M195 永久中立(卡塔尔)，核心在于"血统即合法性+守护即责任+生存即外交"的哈希姆王朝生存范式。
reason_en: Jordan not mere small state but 'Hashemite bloodline + Mecca guardianship + survival diplomacy' trinity dynastic state. Hashemite bloodline connects Prophet/Mecca, Hussein balanced Israel/Palestine/US/Iraq/Gulf/US via survival diplomacy, succession stability ensures dynasty continuity. M173 distinct from M183 Indigenous Self-Determination (Bolivia), M170 Tribal Federalism (Afghanistan), M195 Permanent Neutrality (Qatar), core: 'bloodline as legitimacy + guardianship as duty + survival as diplomacy' Hashemite dynastic survival paradigm.
